title: Why Rice Took the Hit First

intro_meme.prompt: A cartoon rice paddy sits happily flooded and lush, then the water suddenly starts draining away in a giant whirlpool as a shadowy hand shaped like a dollar sign pulls a plug at the bottom, the rice plants looking alarmed.

outro_meme.prompt: A cartoon rice stalk stands back up, dusts itself off, and gives a determined nod while pointing toward a glowing newspaper in the distance labeled 'FULL STORY'.

sources.fact: USDA AMS: national average diesel hit a record $6.285/gal for the week ending Sep 14, 2026.
USDA NASS: Missouri rice planted acreage fell from 213,000 (2025) to 118,000 (2026), a 44.6% decline; soybean planted acreage rose from 5.6M to 5.95M acres.

lines.text: Nate, Missouri rice acreage just fell forty four point six percent. In one damn year.
